name: David Miller
bio:
David Miller is a seasoned HR professional with a passion for motorsport that began in his childhood, attending local races with his father. After graduating with a degree in Human Resources, he spent several years in the corporate world, honing his skills in talent acquisition and employee relations. However, the allure of the racetrack never faded, leading him to seek opportunities within the motorsport industry.

David's approach to HR is rooted in the belief that a motivated and well-supported team is essential for success. He is dedicated to creating a positive and inclusive work environment where every team member feels valued and empowered. He joined Brasil Racing to make a real impact on the team's culture and performance. His innovative approach to employee development and retention sets him apart, always looking for ways to enhance employee engagement and drive team morale.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of average height with a noticeable, friendly smile.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down ideas and observations.
Has a collection of vintage racing posters in his office.
Prefers to conduct team meetings while walking around the paddock to encourage creative thinking.
